title: Total a week of shifts

blocks.text: A timesheet lists shifts, each a start and an end `LocalTime`. Write `Timesheet.total(List<Shift> shifts)`: the total time worked, as the hours, a colon and the minutes in two digits (`7:45`, `0:05`, `41:30`).

items: A shift whose end is before its start **runs past midnight**: `22:00` to `06:00` is 8 hours. An end of `00:00` is midnight at the end of the shift.
The total can exceed a day, and **every hour is shown**: 28 hours and 30 minutes is `28:30`.

blocks.text: `Shift(LocalTime start, LocalTime end)` is given. Shift times are whole minutes, no shift is longer than 24 hours, and no shift has its end equal to its start.

cases.says: Shifts within one day add up to hours and two-digit minutes.
A shift from 22:00 to 06:00 is 8 hours, not 16 and not minus 16.
A total of 28 and a half hours shows as 28:30, not 4:30.

concepts: Duration.between(later, earlier) is negative, so a span that wraps past midnight must be corrected before it is summed.
toHours() gives the total hours of a Duration while toHoursPart() gives only the hours left after whole days.
